== How to use this page ==
This page collects the proposals to change [[Hörmander theory]], from a typo to a new proof, and their discussion. A proposal is opened with the pencil button next to a paragraph in the [https://endipa.github.io edition], or with the link ''new proposal'' under the title of the page (for a section, a statement, a proof). Reply to a proposal with the buttons ''Support'', ''Oppose'' or ''Comment'' in its box, which sign your reply; an associate editor decides, and an editor writes accepted proposals into the page. Applied and declined proposals are moved to {{Proposal archive}}. Questions, ideas for new results and larger changes to the structure of the wiki are discussed on Zulip, channel ''#techniques''. See [[How to contribute#Proposing a change|How to contribute]].
